newsitem.title: JAPAN: HONDA NOT YET DECIDED ON OUTPUT CUT IN THAILAND.
newsitem.headline: HONDA NOT YET DECIDED ON OUTPUT CUT IN THAILAND.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday that it had not yet decided whether it would reduce production in Thailand in line with generally sluggish demand in that country.
"We have made no decision, but we are closely watching the market to see whether we will need some adjustment," a company spokesman said.
Although demand for vehicles in Thailand has been generally dull, sales of passenger cars have been active, the spokesman said, adding that Honda produces only passenger cars in Thailand.
Honda's passenger car sales in Thailand in the January-June period were up 18.6 percent from the same period a year ago, he said.
He said Honda does not expect a planned increase in Thailand's value-added tax to affect its passenger car sales there, as its cars are targeted at consumers with relatively high incomes.
